items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: speaking of an all star band, Jerome Richardson, Shahab, Bud Johnson, Phil Woods, Lennie Johnson, it was just an exciting exciting band. It was a thrill to have them to travel with us.

ctx.x: You say when you met him other saxophonists. In other words he was one three great (Inaudible).

Yeah, he was. And Ben and Coleman Hawkins. But Hawk now, speaking of this same band, Phil Woods, they featured -- one of his featured numbers in Quincy's band was 'Midnight Sun Never Sets,' you know. What is that, 'the Midnight Sun.'
